_comment: Every model checkpoint the project needs, with the bytes and sha256 that
prove a download arrived intact, and where each one comes from.
Weights are NOT in git. GrandQC is CC BY-NC and BEETLE is CC BY-NC-SA, so
this repository has no right to redistribute either, and the trained
tissue_type checkpoints inherit those terms through their training data.
setup.py reads this file, fetches what is missing, and verifies what it
fetched. Run `python setup.py --check` to audit without downloading.
role:  runtime  = the web app cannot run step 2 or step 8 without it
optional = an alternate or ablation checkpoint; the app runs without it
training = only needed to retrain, never loaded when serving
hash:  published    = the upstream archive serves these exact bytes.
local-resave = produced locally by torch.save, so the hash belongs to
this copy rather than to a published asset. setup accepts a byte-size
match with a warning, because a fresh torchvision re-save is not
